crash.dirty_exit.reason: A CLI PROCESS exiting non-zero without an incident. The eval harness drives the engine in-process, so there is no child process to exit dirtily and no shape to script — reproducing this needs a process-level harness the suite does not have. 162 occurrences, all from component 'cli'. Tracked in docs/program/backlog.md.

context.budget_overflow.reason: Requires a context large enough to exceed the assembled budget, which means either a multi-megabyte fixture (slow, and a size the compactor's thresholds would have to be pinned against) or a synthetic budget override the harness cannot express today. Real, worth covering, and out of scope for P7.8 — it needs RunOptions to carry a context-budget override first. 25 occurrences.
